deadline.value: PhD applications are due December 1, 2026, with test scores and three letters received by then.
deadline.quote: Applications for the MS Thesis and PhD programs are due December 1.

gre_general.value: The GRE General is optional for all PhD applicants.
gre_general.quote: GRE general test scores are optional for all applicants to the MS and PhD programs, regardless of prior degrees or other background.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

toefl_min.value: No department minimum; competitive applicants usually have TOEFL 100+ with speaking 23+ (Graduate School minimums apply).
toefl_min.quote: While our department does not have minimum score requirements, most competitive applicants will have: TOEFL total score ≥ 100 TOEFL speaking score ≥ 23

supervisor.value: The admissions pages do not say whether you need a supervisor first.

funding.value: PhD students get up to five years of guaranteed 12-month RA/TA funding (stipend, tuition, insurance) with satisfactory progress.
funding.quote: Students in the PhD program are offered up to five years of guaranteed funding, contingent upon satisfactory academic progress and job performance. | Guaranteed funding covers all 12 months of the year.

entry_route.value: A bachelor's (usually maths/statistics, with about 30 quarter credits of maths and statistics) is enough.
entry_route.quote: Applicants to the MS and PhD program should have a bachelor’s degree or higher.

notes: Saved from the Biostatistics PhD because the Department of Statistics site (stat.uw.edu) returned 502 errors.
